context:
Goal: the Manifest app reaches your iPhone from CI, without your Mac.
Problem (cannot undo): the next step uploads a real build of Manifest to App Store Connect and TestFlight. An uploaded build can be expired but not withdrawn, and it uses up a build number.
Based on (measured): dry run 42745528705 on main 6a55afc passed in 3 min 6 s (build, sign and export, no upload), with TEAM_ID set.
Departs from: main, where builds reach the phone by a Mac install — adds CI uploads to TestFlight.
Meanwhile: the lane waits on this; nothing else waits.
holds: Lane testflight-from-ci waits on this before its first TestFlight upload from CI.

options.gain: The build shows up in TestFlight, ready to install on your phone.
options.how: The lane runs testflight.yml on main once with dry=false, for Manifest only.
options.label: Yes, upload one build
options.lose: One build number is used, and the build cannot be withdrawn.

options.how: No upload. The lane stops after the dry run.
options.label: Not now
options.lose: Phone installs stay on the Mac route.

ref: step testflight-from-ci (TestFlight upload from CI); decision native-ships-via-testflight (iOS ships via TestFlight); item 82 testflight-team-id (TEAM_ID, done); run 42745528705 (dry run on main 6a55afc)
title: Upload the first real Manifest build from CI to TestFlight?
why: The dry run passed with TEAM_ID set, so one upload proves the whole path, and an expired build costs only a build number.
